relay_waiting: ^Narrator: She's already facing the door when it opens, one hand resting on the radio.
^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': Cipher said we had a live one. That'll be you.
relay_patrol_alert: ^Narrator: She comes round the end of the inverter cabinets mid-stride and stops dead.
^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': Inverter room's closed. Has been all week.
^The bypass modules on all three rack banks. Was that you?

c-0: ^Narrator: Her hand is already moving for the radio.
^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': Because I'm meant to be.
c-1: ^Narrator: Her hand stops halfway. She weighs it, and leaves the radio where it is.
c-2: ^Narrator: That stops her harder than a raised voice would.

relay_alerts_team: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': All units, inverter room. We have company.
^Narrator: She clips the radio back on her belt, unhurried.
relay_standoff: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': You're not getting to those rack banks.
relay_standoff_choices: ^(Keep her talking. Step in close enough for the cloner to find her card.)
^I don't need to. I need you to understand what they'll do.
^Walk away. I'm not here for you.

c-2: ^Narrator: She shakes her head, almost friendly.
c-3: ^Narrator: The silence goes on a beat too long.

relay_doubt: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': Thermal runaway in a sealed hall. I know exactly what they'll do. I did the modelling.
^Narrator: There is no flinch in it.
^You modelled the casualties and came anyway.
^Then you know the night crew is still in Hall 2.

c-0: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': I modelled the grid. The casualties were a line in the same spreadsheet.
c-1: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': They were told to clear at midnight. If they didn't, that's on them.

relay_clone: ^Narrator: You let her talk and drift closer while she does, until the cloner on your hip is a hand's width from the card on her belt.
relay_clone_debrief: ^Narrator: The cloner didn't get a clean read. She hasn't noticed. Yet.
relay_clone_missed: ^Narrator: The cloner didn't get a clean read.
relay_clone_caught: ^Narrator: The cloner buzzes once. She hears it.

b: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': ...Was that what I think it was?

relay_clone_caught: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': That was my card. Run, then.
relay_refuses: ^ENTROPY Operative 'Relay': Last chance to be somewhere else.
relay_last_chance: ^(Close the gap before she moves. The cloner's already reading.)
^Then we do this the hard way.
relay_clone_close: ^Narrator: You step inside her reach before she moves, the cloner already reading.
